description: Advance a reservation status: seat, mark attended, or mark no-show. Seating needs a table: a booking without tables fails with table_required, so assign one with reservation.modify first. Pass the same idempotencyKey when you retry after a timeout or an error. Without it a retry is a new write and may create a duplicate.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string for this write. Send the same one again to retry it. Omit it and the server makes a new one.

name: reservation.status
title: Set reservation status
